g.text: Upstream optical FIFO backlog under overload
4 or 8 SFUs · 2 STAs per SFU · 100 ms observation · T4-only input retains the configured T1 fixed profile
Points average available values across 3 matched seeds. Whiskers show the seed min–max.
Backlog counts packets waiting in the optical FIFO. The cutoff excludes later drain events.
